'''Syntherope''' or '''synthrope''', also known as '''synthecord''', was a strong, synthetic rope. Among other things, it was used in [[Ascension gun/Legends|ascension guns]] as a climbing tool which allowed the user to tether themselves and quickly travel upwards or horizontally.

The [[Tunroth]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Kiran Tatch]] was known to use it when capturing his quarry. [[Bandolier/Legends|Bandoliers]] stored them.<ref name="AIR">''[[Alliance Intelligence Reports]]''</ref>

==Description==
Syntherope, produced by [[Degan Explorations/Legends|Degan Explorations]]<ref name="A&EG">''[[Arms & Equipment Guide]]''</ref>, was a thin, lightweight, and extremely strong synthetic rope utilized in nearly every industry across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. The rope's tensile strength was ten times that of [[Durasteel/Legends|durasteel]]. It was made from a mix of natural and synthetic chemicals and textiles, including proteins found in the excretions of many [[Spider/Legends|arachnid]] species.<ref name="EtU" />

Syntherope was sold in twenty meter spools and was used primarily for climbing, rappelling, and securing cargo, though theoretically can be used anywhere that a stout rope would be needed. Syntherope's commonality and usefulness was such that there was a saying that a coil of syntherope could be found at the bottom of every [[Backpack/Legends|backpack]], pannier, and cargo crate within the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EtU" />
